title: Colim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Colim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Colim is a light-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Colim
sections.content:
Location: Sirene - kill any Chorale enemy.

Obtained from Sirene - kill any Chorale enemy.

sections.title: Is the Colim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Agility (C). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
